glossary.definition: (A) "Public works contract" means any contract awarded by a contracting authority for the construction, engineering, alteration, or repair of any public building, public highway, or other public work.
glossary.scope: As used in sections 153.581 and 153.591 of the Revised Code:

glossary.definition: (B) "Contracting authority" means the state, any township, county, municipal corporation, school board, or other governmental entity empowered to award a public works contract, and any construction manager at risk as defined in section 9.33 of the Revised Code or design-build firm as defined in section 153.65 of the Revised Code awarding a subcontract.
glossary.scope: As used in sections 153.581 and 153.591 of the Revised Code:

glossary.definition: (C) "Contractor" means any person, partnership, corporation, or association that has been awarded a public works contract.
